piles.label: Bills with a hole
piles.why: A named take beside a blank one. Look — do not copy the song across a tanda.

piles.label: Panel leftover
piles.why: A panel named a song the matcher would not apply. Listen, then decide.

piles.label: Conflicts
piles.why: A confident panel disagrees with the stored song. Only a listener can settle it.

piles.label: Matcher miss
piles.why: A catalog name in the title the matcher did not credit. Alias, then replay.

piles.label: Unlabeled
piles.why: No dance_form yet. Keys 1–4 stamp it; human outranks keyword.

piles.label: Needs fingerprint
piles.why: No panel, no prose. The audio is the only evidence left — one take at a time.

piles.label: Payloads
piles.why: What sessions landed. Spot-check twenty; revert a row or the whole batch.
